scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:functions && npm run typecheck --workspace=client && npm run typecheck --workspace=server
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=client && npm run build --workspace=server
scripts.dev:cloudflare: npm run build:cloudflare && wrangler pages dev client/dist
scripts.deploy:cloudflare: npm run build:cloudflare && wrangler pages deploy client/dist --project-name aetheros --commit-dirty=true
scripts.lint: npm run lint:functions && npm run lint --workspace=client && npm run lint --workspace=server
